purpose: Teach: 一つ一つ/思いつい/ホラー/満点/秘訣/フィット/ネクタイ/香水

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、宿題、絶対、一つ一つ、絶対、丁寧にやんなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't you dare do your homework so carefully one task at a time.
lines.style: Mock-serious, teasing drawl. Exaggerated emphasis on 'don't you dare' like she's playing a character. Quick, playful energy. Testing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、新しいプレー、絶対、思いついた、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: You came up with a totally new idea just now, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine excitement breaking through. Quick, stumbling over his own words a little. Pleased with himself for noticing. The reveal happens mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ホラー、絶対、映画、絶対、好きだよね、リク
lines.en: You really do like horror movies, don't you, Riku?
lines.style: Soft accusation, almost teasing. Drawn-out, testing tone—like she's catching him in something. Slight smile underneath. Waiting to see if he'll deny it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト、本気で、絶対、満点、絶対、だったの?桜
lines.en: Your test score was perfect, wasn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle wonder. Slight pause before the question, like he's processing it. Sincere curiosity—not competitive, just noticing. Warm undertone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、勉強の、絶対、秘訣、絶対、教えてよ、リク
lines.en: Will you teach me your study trick, Riku?
lines.style: Direct request, but softened by genuine curiosity. Slight lean forward in the voice. Not demanding—actually asking. A little vulnerable under the casual surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のユニフォーム、本気で、絶対、ぴったり、絶対、フィット、絶対、してるな、桜
lines.en: Your uniform looks really sharp on you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Then meeting her eyes with it. Straightforward compliment—no performance. Warm, steady conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、卒業式、絶対、ネクタイ、絶対、似合うかな、リク
lines.en: Do you think a tie will suit you at graduation?
lines.style: Hesitant, testing the question out loud. Vulnerable—she's asking for real feedback. Quick breath before the question, like she's gathering courage. Waiting for his answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、香水、絶対、お洒落だぜ、桜
lines.en: Your cologne is really stylish, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet compliment, almost offhand but clearly genuine. Warm, admiring tone. The kind of thing he noticed and decided to say. Direct and sincere.
